resolution.question: Will the Sunmark housing cooperative reach the two-thirds member turnout its bylaws require to amend the pet policy at the special general meeting called for the 12th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all Sunmark housing cooperative members actually attended (or were represented by proxy, if allowed) the special general meeting on September 12, 2026, before the meeting's conclusion. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
